items.title: CISA adds three new actively exploited vulnerabilities to must-patch list — Adobe Commerce, Google Brotli, Collabora Online
items.summary: CISA added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-48356 affects Adobe Commerce and Magento (unrestricted file upload). CVE-2026-111497 affects Google Brotli (used in Chrome and many apps). CVE-2026-110447 affects Collabora Online (OS command injection). Patch Adobe Commerce/Magento, update Chrome and any software using Brotli, and update Collabora Online immediately. Source: CISA.gov October 27 and 23 2026

items.title: Windows 11 Live Captions transcribes any audio free — great for videos without subtitles
items.summary: Windows 11 has a free built-in Live Captions feature that transcribes any audio playing on your PC in real time. Press Win+Ctrl+L to turn it on. It works offline for English and works on any video, podcast, or meeting. No upload, no account, no cost. Free at microsoft.com/windows/tips/live-captions or just press Win+Ctrl+L.

items.title: Windows 11 25H2 and 26H2 are the new supported versions — free upgrade at Settings > Windows Update if you are on 24H2 Home or Pro
items.summary: Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro reached end of updates October 13 2026. Microsoft now supports 25H2 and 26H2 with monthly security patches. The upgrade is free — go to Settings > Windows Update and check for updates. If your PC says it's up to date on 24H2 you need to manually trigger the version upgrade. Source: Microsoft Support KB5127648 October 13 2026

items.title: Best free password manager 2026 — Bitwarden unlimited devices open source or Proton Pass with email aliases and built-in 2FA
items.summary: Bitwarden offers unlimited passwords and devices for free with open-source code at bitwarden.com. Proton Pass adds email aliases and built-in two-factor authentication free at proton.me/pass. Both work on Windows, Mac, Linux, phones. Source: Security.org, TechDeft, ITsFOSS 2026 comparisons

items.title: One click in Windows Security turns on free ransomware protection — Controlled Folder Access blocks unauthorized encryption
items.summary: Windows 11 has a free ransomware shield built in called Controlled Folder Access. It stops unknown apps from encrypting your documents, pictures, and desktop folders. Open Windows Security (type "Windows Security" in Start), click Virus & threat protection, then Manage ransomware protection, and turn on Controlled Folder Access. Takes 30 seconds. Source: Microsoft Support, How-To Geek, Pureinfotech

items.title: Firefox 159 patches 167 security holes and adds website watch feature — free at firefox.com
items.summary: Mozilla released Firefox 159 on October 28, 2026 addressing 167 vulnerabilities (108 high severity) and enabling the sidebar password manager by default. The new Smart Window feature watches websites for changes like price drops or new content. Get it free at firefox.com or via Firefox menu > Help > About Firefox.

items.title: Clearwave Fiber and Xfinity expand service to 3300 Columbia County addresses — check yours at clearwavefiber.com
items.summary: Clearwave Fiber has expanded its all-fiber infrastructure in Lake City with several thousand residents now able to get fiber internet. Xfinity and Comcast Business also announced high-speed service for 3,300+ homes and businesses in Columbia County. Check your address at clearwavefiber.com or xfinity.com to see if service reached your street.

items.title: Windows 11 24H2 Home Pro editions reached final security update October 13 — KB5127648 is the last one
items.summary: Microsoft confirmed Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro editions reached end of servicing on October 13, 2026. The October Patch Tuesday update KB5127648 is the final monthly security update these editions will receive. No further security patches after this. Check your edition at Settings > System > About and plan your next steps.

items.title: Run private AI chatbots on your computer free offline — Ollama LM Studio Jan GPT4All compared
items.summary: Want ChatGPT-like AI without the cloud? Four free tools let you run models locally: Ollama (command line, ollama.com), LM Studio (graphical, lmstudio.ai), Jan (chat interface, jan.ai), and GPT4All (simple desktop app, gpt4all.io). All work offline, no account needed, your data never leaves your computer. Download any from their official sites.
